document_contracts.description: The code generation execution plan should contain purpose, collaboration rule, workflow delivery order, and execution steps with step-level delivery structure.
The workflow delivery order should remain logically ordered according to the target project delivery phases.
Each execution step should keep a stable structure with status, architecture modules in scope, and batch-oriented delivery items, without requiring a fixed number of steps.

section_contracts.title: Purpose
checkitems: state the target project or target delivery scope
list the source architecture or design documents
explain that the plan is organized by workflow runtime order and architecture module boundaries

section_contracts.title: Collaboration Rule
checkitems: reference one shared collaboration standard document path
state that the execution plan keeps delivery scope and status only
state that collaboration behavior is defined in the shared standard document
section_contracts.expected_format:
All implementation work under this plan must follow the shared collaboration standard:

- `{collaboration_standard_path}`

section_contracts.title: Workflow Delivery Order
checkitems: contain an ordered list of workflow delivery phases
keep the list aligned with the target project implementation order
allow a variable number of workflow phases

section_contracts.title: Execution Steps
checkitems: contain step-oriented delivery sections that align with workflow delivery order
allow a variable number of top-level step subsections
keep each step in a status plus scope plus batch structure

section_contracts.title: Step {n}. Deliver {step_name}
checkitems: contain one or more batch-oriented delivery items
allow step names, modules, and batch counts to vary by project
section_contracts.expected_format:
- [ ] `Step {n} is not started`
- [ ] `Architecture modules in scope`
  - [ ] `{module_1}`
- [ ] `Batch 1: {batch_1_name}`
